Metaldehyde is primarily used as a molluscicide, which means it's used to control mollusks like slugs and snails that can damage crops. It's often formulated into baits or pellets that are spread around crops to protect them from these pests.

A. an agent to control slugs and snails - This matches with metaldehyde's use as a molluscicide
B. acaricide - This would be for controlling mites and ticks
C. agent against aphids - This would be for controlling aphids
D. total herbicide - This would be for killing all plants/weeds
